class.name: StyleBox
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for defining stylized boxes for UI elements.
class.description: [StyleBox] is an abstract base class for drawing stylized boxes for UI elements. It is used for panels, buttons, [LineEdit] backgrounds, [Tree] backgrounds, etc. and also for testing a transparency mask for pointer signals. If mask test fails on a [StyleBox] assigned as mask to a control, clicks and motion signals will go through it to the one below. [b]Note:[/b] For control nodes that have [i]Theme Properties[/i], the [code]focus[/code] [StyleBox] is displayed over the [code]normal[/code], [code]hover[/code] or [code]pressed[/code] [StyleBox]. This makes the [code]focus[/code] [StyleBox] more reusable across different nodes.

method.name: _get_minimum_size
method.description: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a custom minimum size that the stylebox must respect when drawing. By default [method get_minimum_size] takes the style's border and content padding into account. This method can be overridden to add another size restriction. A combination of the default behavior and the output of this method will be used, to account for both sizes.

method.name: draw
method.description: Draws this stylebox using a canvas item identified by the given [RID]. The [RID] value can either be the result of [method CanvasItem.get_canvas_item] called on an existing [CanvasItem]-derived node, or directly from creating a canvas item in the [RenderingServer] with [method RenderingServer.canvas_item_create].

method.name: get_content_margin
method.description: Returns the content padding of the specified [enum Side], excluding the style's border. Use [method get_margin] to retrieve the total inset used for layout.

method.name: get_current_item_drawn
method.description: Returns the [CanvasItem] that handles its [constant CanvasItem.NOTIFICATION_DRAW] or [method CanvasItem._draw] callback at this moment.

method.name: get_margin
method.description: Returns the total content inset for the specified [enum Side], including the style's border and content padding. For [StyleBoxFlat], this is the border width plus the content margin. For [StyleBoxTexture], this is the texture margin plus the content margin. Positive values reduce size inwards, unlike [Control]'s margin values.

method.name: get_minimum_size
method.description: Returns the minimum size that this stylebox can be shrunk to, including its border and content padding.

method.name: get_offset
method.description: Returns the "offset" of a stylebox. This helper function returns a value equivalent to [code]Vector2(style.get_margin(MARGIN_LEFT), style.get_margin(MARGIN_TOP))[/code].

method.name: set_content_margin
method.description: Sets the content padding of the specified [enum Side] to [param offset] pixels. This padding is added inside the style's border. Negative values are clamped to [code]0[/code].

method.name: set_content_margin_all
method.description: Sets the content padding to [param offset] pixels for all sides. This padding is added inside the style's border. Negative values are clamped to [code]0[/code].

method.name: test_mask
method.description: Test a position in a rectangle, return whether it passes the mask test.

members.member: The bottom padding for the contents of this style box, added inside the style's border. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the bottom. Negative values are clamped to [code]0[/code]. For example, a [StyleBoxFlat] with a [code]1[/code]-pixel bottom border and [code]4[/code] pixels of bottom content padding has a total bottom inset of [code]5[/code] pixels. It is up to the code using this style box to decide what these contents are: for example, a [Button] respects this content margin for the textual contents of the button. Code laying out contents should use [method get_margin] to include both the style's border and content padding.

The left padding for the contents of this style box, added inside the style's border. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the left. Refer to [member content_margin_bottom] for extra considerations.

The right padding for the contents of this style box, added inside the style's border. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the right. Refer to [member content_margin_bottom] for extra considerations.

The top padding for the contents of this style box, added inside the style's border. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the top. Refer to [member content_margin_bottom] for extra considerations.
